ITAScanner Support

ITAScanner requires an iPhone with iOS 17 or later. Camera scanning requires a real iPhone. The app does not require an account or an app server.

Scan and recognize text

Start a document with the camera or a photo stored on the iPhone. If the camera is unavailable, allow camera access in iPhone Settings. Place the page on a flat surface in even light.

Before saving, review the page edges and orientation. Use the text preview to compare recognized text with the original. Small text, curved pages, handwriting, shadows, and low light can reduce recognition quality. The app does not provide book-curve correction or editable Word and Excel conversion.

Import a photo or PDF

If photo import fails, make sure that the app can access the selected photo in iPhone Settings. Limited Photos access is supported. The photo must be available on the device. ITAScanner does not download an iCloud-only photo original. If needed, save the original on your iPhone through Photos before importing it again.

If a PDF requires a password, enter its opening password. The app keeps the imported original's password, text, and annotations. Locked PDFs cannot be merged through the multi-file merge action. The app has no password recovery service.

Save and organize documents

A new scan supports up to 20 pages. PDF storage, merge, and page editing support up to 80 MB and 100 pages. If a document exceeds a limit, divide it into smaller documents. Scan images are resized for memory use, so small details can lose resolution.

Page edits and annotations are saved as a new PDF. Make sure that the new file looks correct before removing an older copy. A handwritten signature is a visible mark, not a certificate-based digital signature. Portrait background replacement does not verify official passport or ID-photo rules.

To recover a document moved to trash, use the document management menu to restore the trash. The current restore action restores all documents in the trash. If storage is full, free space on the iPhone before saving again.

Keep copies outside the app

Export important PDFs yourself. The app's document library and trash are excluded from iCloud and device backups. Deleting the app or losing the device can remove your only copy.

Sharing and printing use the destination you select. A selected app, file provider, or printer can use its own network service. ITAScanner does not control those services.

Report a beta issue

If you use TestFlight, send feedback from TestFlight. Include the iPhone model, iOS version, app version and build, and steps that reproduce the issue. Describe the result you expected and the result you saw. If you attach a screenshot, remove private document content first.

Contact support

Send support requests to the public contact. Include the device and app version and a description of the issue. Remove private document content from attachments.
